An AsciiDoc table cell effectively creates a nested document. As such, it inherits attributes from the parent document. If an attribute is set or explicitly unset in the parent document, it

be modified in the AsciiDoc table cell. There are a handful of exceptions to this rule, which includes doctype, toc, notitle (and its complement, showtitle), and compat-mode. Any newly defined attributes in the AsciiDoc table do not impact the attributes in the parent document. Instead, these attributes are scoped to the table cell.
